documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Considering And Approving, Among Other Matters, The Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026.
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM

analysis.summary: SK Minerals & Additives reported revenue of Rs. 318 crores for FY26, representing 50% growth from FY25, with EBITDA margins expanding from 9% to 10%. The company plans to invest approximately Rs. 20 crores in CAPEX over FY27 and FY28 to increase manufacturing capacity to 18,000 metric tons. Management currently has an order book of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase the revenue contribution from manufacturing from 23% to 50% over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: Currently, 23% of our revenue comes from the manufacturing capabilities, but in the next two to three years, we want to scale the manufacturing contribution to turnover to 50%, with overall increase in turnover also.

guidance.claim: The company is working to improve EBITDA margins by strengthening manufacturing capabilities and building economies of scale.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margins, we are working to improve because we are trying to strengthen our manufacturing capabilities.

demand_outlook.claim: Raw material demand rose sharply from December onwards, with prices increasing significantly in February.
demand_outlook.quote: So, we have sourced the material for next six months or suddenly there was demand from December onwards of these raw materials and the prices have increased tremendously in February of these raw materials.

demand_outlook.claim: SK Minerals is focusing its flame-retardant products on the cable and wire and electrical equipment industries.
demand_outlook.quote: This flame-retardant is being used in various industries, but currently, we are focusing on cable and wire and electrical and electronics equipment.

demand_outlook.claim: The company plans to target EV batteries after establishing presence in cable, wire, and electrical equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Once we cater to these two segments, then we will target EV batteries also.

demand_outlook.claim: SK Minerals is receiving queries for its products from international buyers.
demand_outlook.quote: As currently, we are getting a few queries from the international buyers also.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired 9.6 acres of land to build a polymer additives and compounding facility.
capex_expansion.quote: First of all, this 9.6 acre land which we have taken is for developing our polymer additives and polymer compound facility, whereas specified that in next 12 to 18 months, we will be taking our manufacturing capabilities to 18,000 metric tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recently set up a polymer additives plant with a capacity of 400 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: In terms of polymer additives, we have recently set up 400 metric ton plant per month, but there are some teething problems going on which we will try to address in the next three months and that will be also utilized fully in the next six months’ timeline.

margins_costs.claim: Margin contraction in the second half of FY26 was driven by rising raw material prices from January onwards.
margins_costs.quote: It is because of the increase in the prices of raw materials. And as I have said prices have increased specifically, from January onwards, the prices of raw material have increased.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects margins from polymer additives to reach around 40%.
margins_costs.quote: Currently, in terms of the manufacturing margins, we are standing at 30% approximately, whereas from polymer additives, we feel that the margins would be 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: SK Minerals currently maintains an order book of approximately Rs. 55 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, order book is around about Rs. 55 crore and it depends upon the customer.

orders_capacity.claim: Government customers account for Rs. 42 crores of the total Rs. 55 crore order book.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of these Rs. 55 crores, Rs. 42 crores is from government and rest is from private.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization in the food and feed segment is currently around 95%.
orders_capacity.quote: Secondly, current capacity utilization is approximately 95% in food and feed segment and we have set up one food segment also which is almost optimally used.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current installed capacity stands at 6,600 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: The current capacity is 6600 metric tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's working capital cycle stands at 110 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Currently, working capital cycle is of 110 days.

capital_allocation.claim: Planned CAPEX will be funded through bank credit lines and unutilized IPO proceeds.
capital_allocation.quote: We have the credit lines available for CAPEX from the banks also. And we have some part of the IPO proceeds which we have raised for CAPEX.

capital_allocation.claim: Management is working to reduce the working capital cycle to improve organizational cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are working on reducing the working capital cycle that will help us in improving our cash flows in the organization.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues have impacted import trading inventory as available stock gets depleted.
risks_headwinds.quote: In terms of the import trading, yes, it has impacted because we have three months’ stock always available with us.

risks_headwinds.claim: The new polymer additives plant is experiencing initial teething problems during trials.
risks_headwinds.quote: In terms of polymer additives, we have recently set up 400 metric ton plant per month, but there are some teething problems going on which we will try to address in the next three months and that will be also utilized fully in the next six months’ timeline.

risks_headwinds.claim: Entry into polymer additives involves technical, technological, and R&D barriers.
risks_headwinds.quote: In terms of barrier, there are technical and technological barriers. There are R&D barriers.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to increase manufacturing's share of revenue to 50% over the next two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: Currently, 23% of our revenue comes from the manufacturing capabilities, but in the next two to three years, we want to scale the manufacturing contribution to turnover to 50%, with overall increase in turnover also.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to file three patents in the next six months.
management_commitments.quote: But in next six months, we will try to file three patents.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
